column3: “His” is supplied with love; inward parts is rendered “affection.”
United in soul and minding the one thing is rendered “united in spirit and purpose.”
The clause about being found in appearance as a man is moved to verse 8.
The opening clause about human appearance belongs to verse 7 in the Greek numbering.
“To the highest place” expands highly exalted.
“Continue to” is supplied; own is not expressed separately.
“His” is supplied; “good purpose” renders good pleasure.
“Else like him” renders like-souled; “needs” specifies things concerning you.
Sent is rendered “am ... eager to send.”
